featured.name: Endometriosis Survey Engine
featured.desc: Self-hosted replacement for Google Forms, made for a nursing-school thesis. Surveys are rows in the database, not code. It has two languages, an SVG body map for marking pain, and autosave with resume. The graded awareness quiz keeps its answer key on the server. CSV export uses stable question codes. No IP or user-agent is stored next to a health answer.

featured.name: Home Camera AI Detection
featured.desc: Real-time monitoring with a Luxonis OAK-D LR depth camera. It detects people and vehicles and draws heatmaps. It also counts line crossings and watches zones like the property gate.

featured.name: Steam CZ Behavior Analysis
featured.desc: Semestral project at VŠE about ten years of Czech Steam user behavior. Changepoint detection and cohort analysis, plus seasonal decomposition. Comes with a paper and a presentation.

featured.name: Gemma - Discord Voice Bot
featured.desc: A bot that joins voice channels, listens with faster-whisper, asks a local LLM and answers out loud with Piper TTS. Self-hosted in an LXC container.

featured.name: Full-stack E-shop
featured.desc: E-shop with a Flask backend and a React frontend. Has JWT auth, a local cart and Stripe payments.

archive.name: Instagram Chat Analyzer
archive.desc: Offline tool that turns exported Instagram DM JSON into stats and plots. Made for myself.

archive.name: Products REST API
archive.desc: Token-authenticated product API that syncs prices and stock from an external service. Runs in Docker, has tests, monitored with Grafana.

archive.name: AC Automation
archive.desc: HVAC control with an ESP8266 and PWM DACs, hooked into Home Assistant, in a 3D-printed enclosure. It still runs.
